description: T200 in a tow tank at a fixed PWM command of 1700 us (34.5 rev/s, open-loop, no speed feedback), 14.8 V nominal LiPo supply, advance ratio J = Va/(n D), D = 0.076 m. Thrust and battery current versus J. Points are read from Figs. 16 and 17 (approximate, reading uncertainty about 0.2 N and 0.05 A); the linear fits are as printed.
measured_vs_derived: thrust, carriage speed and battery current measured; rotational speed taken from the bench PWM-to-rpm map, not measured during towing

current_A.note: the printed intercept 4.51 A does not match the plotted line or the markers (about 4.15 A at J = 0); use the points

limitations: single command level usable (the 11.6 rev/s series is anomalous, efficiency above 1)
single supply voltage (14.8 V nominal), no voltage measurement series reported
no uncertainty or repeat statistics for the dynamic runs
electrical power versus J not plotted; current only
